h: Rita Daniels reacts to rumours of a rift with her daughter Regina Daniels
p: Nollywood actress Rita Daniels has reportedly responded to talk online that she has fallen out with her daughter, actress Regina Daniels. She is said to have questioned why the person spreading the claim did not show his face.
more: The rumours follow months of public attention on the Daniels family.
Fans have been reacting in the comments.
